events.headline: Nvidia chair dismisses idea of rehiring Huang and vows fast search
events.summary: Nvidia forecast fourth-quarter revenue of $130 billion plus or minus 3%, above estimates, while its board rejected reinstating Jensen Huang and began a permanent CEO search. Third-quarter revenue reached $115.84 billion.

events.headline: 'Business as usual': Nvidia's Kress passes first test as board slams door on Huang
events.summary: Interim CEO Colette Kress pledged capital discipline and said supplier relationships remained strong. Nvidia neocloud investments fell to $32 billion from $36 billion in the preceding quarter.

events.headline: Asia stocks cling to gains after Nvidia earnings as Anthropic pricing looms
events.summary: Asian stocks struggled to sustain gains after Nvidia's upbeat outlook as leadership uncertainty persisted. Investors awaited Anthropic's IPO pricing and monitored weaker oil prices.

events.headline: Gold slips to over one-year low on firm dollar, US rate outlook
events.summary: Spot gold fell roughly 1.9% to $3,777.83 per ounce as the dollar and US Treasury yields rose. Markets priced a high probability of a December Federal Reserve rate hike.

events.headline: Dollar holds near 19-month high as data supports case for US rate hikes
events.summary: The dollar held near a 19-month peak after US retail-sales data and Federal Reserve comments strengthened rate-hike expectations. The yen was supported by Bank of Japan tightening signals.

events.headline: Oil prices fall as higher US crude stocks temper supply risks
events.summary: Brent and WTI fell after industry data showed a 5.28-million-barrel rise in US crude inventories. Attacks around the Strait of Hormuz continued to constrain shipping and limited declines.

events.headline: Indian shares slip after settling at nine-month high
events.summary: Indian stocks declined after a strong November rally and substantial foreign inflows. Metal and financial shares fell amid a stronger dollar and profit taking.

events.headline: Nvidia leaves the AI trade hanging in purgatory
events.summary: Reuters Breakingviews commentary argued Nvidia's unresolved succession and uncertainty around financing of smaller AI cloud providers could prolong AI-sector valuation risk. This is opinion analysis, not an independently established forecast.

events.headline: Morning Bid: Jensen Huang's last hurrah, and a nervy future for Nvidia
events.summary: Reuters market commentary said Nvidia had beaten quarterly revenue expectations for 17 consecutive quarters, but governance and financing concerns continued to weigh on investor confidence.
